_meta.openai/widgetDescription: iPayX FX forensic audit result. Shows FX Score, spread, overpayment vs mid-market benchmark.

description: Audits one FX transaction against its UTC reference minute candle, or the 13:00–21:00 UTC hourly average when only a date is supplied. Returns FX Score 0-10, non-negative spread in bps and percent, estimated overpayment with currency, reference provider and UTC candle evidence. Weekend transactions use the last available candle and are flagged.

examples.name: USD→CAD wire of 250k at a 1.2% spread

bank_rate.description: Rate the bank/broker actually charged (alias: taux)

language.description: Optional output language. Auto-detected from input keys (montant/taux → fr) when omitted.

transaction_date.description: Transaction date YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO timestamp with timezone.

name: audit_fx_transaction
title: Audit FX Transaction
